facts.fact: The Sierra Leone Police launched its 2024 Crime Statistics Report on 5 March 2025, recording 29,015 criminal and road traffic offences in 2024 against 30,491 in 2023, per Regional Commander AIG Koroma.
The Inspector General of Police called the Sierra Leone Police the authoritative source of crime statistics, and the report counts offences the police recorded in 2024.

SLE.note: Crime counts only (statistics class); no station-level digital record stated.
